facts.fact: Angola's Ministry of Telecommunications (MINTTICS) put a draft AI law in public consultation from September 2025, with penalties for discrimination, hate via algorithms, privacy violations and harm to the democratic process, and a future AI Authority.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligencia Artificial

AGO.note: The document states no government use of AI, only a draft AI law.

facts.fact: Angola's Ministry of Telecommunications (MINTTICS) has had a draft AI law in public consultation since September 2025, with prison terms of 1 to 12 years and fines up to Kz 1.5 billion for firms.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligencia Artificial

AGO.note: The document states no AI tool in a sector's public system; it describes a draft law only.
The document states no AI model, dataset or computing built in Angola.
The consultation is stated but not shown to have run online.

facts.fact: Angola's Ministry of Telecommunications (MINTTICS) placed its draft AI law in public consultation from September 2025; an industry CEO, Sergio Lopes of New Cognito, commented on it to the newspaper.
